perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Magnificent Howl
perks.desc: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Gun and Run
perks.desc: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Aggressive(180) Solar Hand Cannon Primary Ammo. "Trust has also returned to us from the archives. Being able to roll more perks than ever before is both a blessing and a curse. Rapid Hit is best in slot, Outlaw or Triple Tap are great for a quick reload or extending the magazine. Incandescent will clear groups of enemies, but 180 hand cannons just aren’t PvE meta. They do feel fantastic to shoot, I will give them that. Frenzy will bring up your reload so you won’t necessarily need a reload perk, and Solar is an easy enough class to keep Golden Tricorn up consistently. Whichever floats your boat."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Range. Aggressive(180) Solar Hand Cannon Primary Ammo. "I am sad that Trust gained such a large perk pool as investing into all range will feel phenomenal. Rapid Hit will bring up your stability. A 180 hand cannon with 33m of range is incredible. You can also roll flinch machines with Opening Shot and Explosive Payload for slightly less range but great chip damage from afar. Depending on if you swap to Trust or feel like it will be your main weapon you can also opt for Eye of the Storm for better dueling, 180s have a slow time to kill so Eye of the Storm will keep your aim assist high at the end of that duel."
